classification_policy.safe_durable: Organization-level policy, blank forms, vendor implementation material, non-person-specific plan summaries, recruiting advertisements, reusable training resources.
classification_policy.restricted_local: Completed applications, employee medical/leave/workers-comp records, payroll/tax records, benefit enrollments, salary census, FSA receipts, invoices with sensitive/account detail, verification records and other person-level case files.
classification_policy.noise_ephemeral: Inline logos/signature graphics, delivery-transcript artifacts, duplicate decorative images, non-work/personal items.
classification_policy.security_sensitive: Calendar/meeting files or messages containing join links, passcodes, tokens, recovery/security values; only sanitized event/process metadata may be durable.
